# SOP-P3-L2-04 Shift handover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Purpose: Controlled handover between outgoing and incoming operators for the Ring Rolling line.

Preconditions
1. Outgoing operator present at handover location.
2. All machine fault indicators cleared and acknowledged.
3. All completed production logs updated in the line binder.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear.
2. Arc-rated clothing as required when performing electrical isolation verification.

Procedure (numbered steps)
1. Visual and status check
   1.1. Confirm EQ-P3-L2-SB01 scrap bin is accessible and not obstructed.
   1.2. Confirm EQ-P3-L2-RR02 control panel shows ready state; verify no active alarms.
   1.3. Confirm EQ-P3-L2-HT03 control panel shows ready state; verify no active alarms.
2. Product verification
   2.1. Verify documentation for current work order matches parts staged.
   2.2. Verify the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.
3. Heat treat confirmation
   3.1. Confirm furnace recipe loaded on EQ-P3-L2-HT03 matches work order.
   3.2. Confirm the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds.
4. Safety and isolation
   4.1. Demonstrate emergency stop functionality for each cell to incoming operator.
   4.2. Verify lockout/tagout records for any maintenance work in progress.
5. Documentation and logover
   5.1. Outgoing operator reviews any deviations, non-conformances, or corrective actions with incoming operator.
   5.2. Update the shift handover log with current part number, batch, and last inspection result.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-019
- MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3
- MM-P3-L2-SB01

Sign-off
1. Outgoing operator name and signature: ____________________
2. Incoming operator name and signature: ____________________
3. Supervisor review: ____________________ Date: __________
